fact: Paratus Group says it invested a further N$600 million (US$33.7 million) in the last year in its new private mobile network in Namibia, one-third of it for a digital technology stack, on top of N$1.42 billion (US$79.8 million) invested in network infrastructure since 2018; the year is taken from the 2025-09-04 publication date.
Finance tables: Paratus Group committed USD 34 million (Self Funded, Active) to Paratus Namibia, starting 2025: Paratus — Namibia private mobile network, 2025.

RMB Namibia, a bank in Namibia, announced on 25 March 2026 a seven-year N$405 million social loan to Telecom Namibia, the state-owned operator, for network modernisation and broadband expansion (NAMPA). Added by the parent: a private lender's money into a state-owned operator counts.
